index.chunking: InsightEdge chunk_text; 1400 character chunks; 280 character overlap

limitations: Only questions with annotated expected_doc_ids are scored; the high_level and info_not_found items without document-ID labels are excluded.
Expected document IDs are gold at the document level, not at the chunk level; gold-document chunk share is a proxy and does not establish passage-level entailment.
This experiment isolates chunk retrieval and source selection; it does not evaluate language-model answer correctness or citation entailment.
The experiment uses SQLite FTS5 BM25; InsightEdge serving also uses dense-priority hybrid candidates, so the BM25 results do not directly establish end-to-end hybrid gains.
A bounded selector can still trade chunk precision for source recall; retrieval labels do not establish answer correctness or citation entailment.

retrieval.method: SQLite FTS5 BM25 over InsightEdge-style 1400-character chunks with 280-character overlap

limitations: This is retrieval-only and does not score generated answers or citation entailment.
The 301 null queries are counted but are not used for an abstention metric in this experiment.
The dataset is smaller and news-domain, so it complements rather than replaces the enterprise corpus result.

method.training_objective: For each outer fold, maximize document recall on training queries subject to gold-document chunk share staying within the stated absolute drop from global BM25; ties prefer higher chunk share, then the stricter gate.
method.deployment_route: The fixed InsightEdge multi-source intent rule selects which queries receive the gate.
method.score_gate: Admit an outside-top-k source candidate only if its FTS5 BM25 magnitude is at least ratio times the original kth candidate's magnitude.

limitations: The held-out folds are query-level splits from one synthetic enterprise benchmark; they are not an independent corpus or domain replication.
The source-coverage intent route is fixed during this evaluation but was previously inspected on this benchmark.
Gold labels identify supporting documents, not relevant passages; gold-document chunk share is a proxy, not citation entailment.
This isolates BM25 retrieval and evidence selection; it does not establish end-to-end hybrid RAG answer quality.
